S3_definition: exactly k distinct feature positions per row replaced with training-derived medians; independently generated for each compound condition
S4_definition: top-k important features globally replaced with training-derived medians; ranking restored from frozen Step 12.5
S5_definition: frozen attack-enriched Step 12.6 population; no balanced-major/minority-enriched compounds because those sensitivity populations are sample-size limited
interaction_analysis: compound degradation compared descriptively with individual-shift degradation; no sign assumed a priori
